Maya (CSM): FYI RetentionBot flagged BluePeak — 45% drop in DAU last 14d. Renewal in ~18d. Looking to spin up a short save plan. Anyone free to help draft a micro-play?
RetentionBot: Alert: account=BluePeak | metric=DAU drop 45% | note=featureX usage down 60% | severity=medium | action_reco=reachout+triage
Ravi (CS Ops): Proposal: 3-step micro-save
 - 24h: quick 20m enablement call + live checklist
 - 3d: targeted troubleshooting (SSO/webhook) + 1-week free support hours
 - 7d: measure signal; if <10% lift -> offer 1-month "stabilize" credit or controlled downgrade buffer
Maya (CSM): Nice. Need copy for outreach + in-app nudge. Want it low-friction, not salesy.
Olivia (Support): Saw ticket #4521 — SSO webhook failing intermittently since Mar 2. That explains login dip. Escalating to infra, will try a hotfix today.
Jordan (AE): If they push on cost, recommend credit > discount. We keep ARR intact and avoid price precedent. I can sign off on a one-month credit if ops confirms recovery effort.
Maya (CSM): Draft outreach — please tweak:
``
Subject: Quick help with BluePeak flows?
Hi Sam —
We noticed a recent drop in activity on [featureX]. Nothing to worry about, but we’d love to hop on a 20m call to walk the flow and make sure everything’s working for your team. No sales pitch — just help.
Are you free tomorrow 11am or 3pm?
Thanks,
Maya
``
Ravi (CS Ops): Looks good. Suggest adding an optional troubleshooting checklist link and an in-app CTA that opens the calendar. Also add: "If you prefer we can patch and follow up with a short recording."
Maya (CSM): Plan: I’ll send the email + calendar invite for 11am tomorrow. Olivia will prioritize SSO hotfix. Jordan holds the credit window. RetentionBot: please set escalation if no 10% uplift within 7d.
RetentionBot: Escalation rule updated: monitor featureX-DAU | threshold=+10% improvement | window=7d | on_fail=trigger-downgrade-buffer-procedure
Olivia (Support): Hotfix deployed to staging; rolling to prod in 30m. Monitoring auth events. :white_check_mark:
Sam (BluePeak): Thanks for flagging — 11am works. Appreciate the proactive reach.
Maya (CSM): Scheduled. Post-call we’ll capture outcome and update the playbook:
 - owner=Maya (CSM): run enablement call
 - owner=Olivia (Support): confirm SSO resolved + monitor 3d
 - owner=Jordan (AE): approve/decline stabilize credit if needed
 - owner=Ravi (CS Ops): update playbook checklist and in-app CTA
Jordan (AE): Marking account as at-risk in CRM and holding discount authority.
RetentionBot: Note added to account timeline: playbook=capture-loop-retention-pulse | owner=Maya (CSM) | status=active
Maya (CSM): Post-call next steps (if call goes well): 1) send recording & checklist, 2) set 7d adoption pulse, 3) close save if +20% adoption. If not, escalate to credit + controlled downgrade buffer. Keeping this thread as the trace log. :spiral_notepad:
